description: Find particular inbound emails: a full-text query (q) over subject, body, sender and recipient, or filters on sender, recipient, subject, body, attachments, spam score, or the sent email they reply to, ranked by relevance or date. To page through the inbox newest first, or to wait for mail that has not arrived yet, use listEmails. Each row is id, thread_id, received_at, from, to, subject, status, direction, awaiting and snippet, with attachment_count, reply_count and automated when they apply; open one with getEmail. Result: emails (the matches), cursor for the next page (null at the end), sort, partial when the time limit cut the page short, total, total_capped and total_unavailable when set, and with include_facets: facets, facets_capped and facets_unavailable.

body.description: Words from the message text to match.

cursor.description: Where the next page starts: the cursor of the page before.

date_from.description: Only rows whose received_at is at or after this date or time (UTC unless it has an offset).

date_to.description: Only rows whose received_at is at or before this; a bare date covers that whole day (UTC).

domain_id.description: One of your receiving domains, by the id getInboxStatus returns.

from.description: Who sent it: a full address, or a domain for everyone there.

full.description: Return the stored record, with envelope addresses, message id and spam score, instead of the compact view for reading.

has_attachment.description: Filter to emails that have (true) or lack (false) attachments.

include_facets.description: Set true to also get counts by sender, domain, status and attachment presence across the whole result set.

limit.description: How many matches this call returns; follow cursor for more.

q.description: Words to find in the subject, body, sender or recipient; each added word narrows the results. Understands quoted phrases, upper-case OR, and filters such as from:, subject: and has:attachment.

reply_to_sent_email_id.description: Find the replies to one of your sends, by the id sendEmail or listSentEmails returned.

snippet.description: Whether rows read with full: true carry highlighted match fragments for a text query. The body snippet on each row is returned either way.

sort.description: Order of results. Left out, best match first when there is text to rank (q, subject or body), else newest first. Use received_at_asc with date_from to poll for new mail.

spam_score_gte.description: Filter to emails with a spam score at or above this value.

spam_score_lt.description: Filter to emails with a spam score strictly below this value.

status.description: Processing stage: pending or accepted while in progress, completed when done, rejected if a filter or check refused it.

subject.description: Words from the subject line to match.

to.description: Which of your addresses it was sent to.

name: searchEmails

outputSchema.description: Inbound emails matching the search, and the cursor for the next page.

cursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null at the end.

emails.description: The matching emails, in sort order.

attachment_count.description: Attachments. Compact rows leave it out when 0.

automated.description: Sent by a machine. Compact rows set it only when true.

awaiting.description: Whose turn, when known: you (not yet answered) or them.

created_at.description: full only: when it was stored.

direction.description: inbound, when given: every row here is a received email.

from.description: Sender, as the From header shows it.

highlights.description: full only, with q: matched fragments.

id.description: Email id, for getEmail and getConversation.

reply_count.description: Replies you sent to it. Compact rows leave it out when 0.

snippet.description: Start of the body; null when there is none.

spam_score.description: full only: spam score; higher is spammier.

status.description: Processing stage: pending, accepted, completed or rejected.

thread_id.description: Conversation id; null when it is in none.

facets.description: With include_facets: counts over the matches; see facets_capped.

by_domain.description: Matches per sender domain, most first.

by_status.description: Matches per processing stage, most first.

facets_capped.description: Set, true, when facets count only the first matches up to the cap.

facets_unavailable.description: Set, true, when facets were asked for but did not fit the time budget.

partial.description: True when the page stopped at its time limit before it filled; cursor continues the search.

sort.description: How the rows are ordered, when given: relevance, received_at_desc or received_at_asc.

total.description: Matches, when counted; absent when the count was skipped or ran out of time.

total_capped.description: True when total stopped at its cap and is a lower bound.

total_unavailable.description: Set, true, when the count did not fit its time budget, so total is absent.

title: Search inbound emails
